name: JamesOS
author: Aaron Grando
description: A groovebox for the FM-1 with three synth tracks, four drum lanes, 24 Plaits engines, 128 starting sounds, a pattern arranger and a 64-step sequencer. Shape your mix with track effects, shared reverb and master controls.
credits: Built on Dinghy by zvenson and Felucca by Leo Kuroshita and Hügelton Instruments, with SLOOP contributions; Plaits, Braids and stmlib keep their MIT licences; JamesOS-K's SMK-37 Pro input and display transport derive from M. Geisler's Felucca SMK-37 port.
